rapport_notes: Patient with a very complex multi-location, two-day, long-distance move, but the price recitation was dense and hard to follow.

evidence_quotes.agenda: not asked - rep went straight from the quid pro quo into logistics questions
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised real pricing-clarity concerns mid-call ("I'm having difficulty calculating what the estimate is going to be," "is there a flat rate?", "I don't know that the two apartments are going to fit in a 26 foot truck") and got substantive but not deeply-probing responses each time

top_strength: Proposed a flexible truck-count structure (offering to cancel the second truck if unnecessary) rather than overselling capacity upfront, protecting the customer from paying for two trucks he might not need.
coaching_note: The estimate delivery was dense and number-heavy - the customer explicitly said he was having difficulty calculating it live on the call; breaking the two-day, two-truck estimate into smaller confirmed chunks would land better.
